localGuide.title: Car Rental in Aliağa
paragraphs: Rentwin rents cars by the day, week and month from its office on 356. Sokak in Atatürk Mahallesi, central Aliağa. Besides cars, the fleet has panel vans, a double-cab pickup and a passenger van; pick your vehicle up at our office and bring it back there when you are done.

Most of the demand for rental vehicles in Aliağa comes from the industrial zone. We rent cars and commercial vehicles by the month to crews working at the STAR Refinery, Petkim, ALOSBİ and the Nemrut Bay ports, and to the companies working at these sites, with invoices in the company's name.

If you fly into İzmir on your way to Aliağa, you can collect your car at İzmir Adnan Menderes Airport. For trips towards Foça, Yeni Foça, Çandarlı, Menemen and Bergama, you can pick the car up from our Aliağa office.

To rent, you need to be at least 25 and have held a driving licence for at least 3 years; we do not take a deposit. We're open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Our prices exclude VAT and are listed for every model on the price list.
